objective: Run adapter version 12 end to end in strict complete mode inside the active shared Chrome window for an included Link-to-Nature record, a retained unresolved exact day, and a proved post-cutoff exclusion.
supersession_basis: Browser-level Playwright CDP attachment waited for every pre-existing page to initialize and timed out while another adapter was active. Adapter version 12 now creates and attaches only its own target through the shared browser harness. Repeat all readiness events in the shared browser while the other job remains active.

acceptance_checks: Each event publishes a strict complete normal JSON and terminal Springer commit marker.
Each event completes two reconciled card-path passes.
Each event saves both mandatory sibling screenshots.
Every compact JSON records target_scoped_shared_cdp as its browser transport.
The Nature canonical metadata URL persists through normalized route evidence.
The unresolved exact day remains retained and counted.
The proved post-cutoff record remains in route accounting and is absent from normalized results.
Final response status is not checked and no request is made to the Nature canonical URL.
The target-scoped daemon closes its owned tab without touching concurrent tabs.
